# Source Code

#### Course: Learn Recursion With C++

## Source Code

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4int calculate_sum(int n) {
5
6    if (n == 1) {
7        return 1;
8    }
9    
10    // Before: return calculate_sum(n-1)
11    // Now: add n to the return value of recursive call
12    return n + calculate_sum(n - 1);
13}
14
15int main() {
16
17    int result = calculate_sum(3);
18    cout << result;
19
20    return 0;
21}
22
23// Output: 6
```
